lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-intensity, quasi-circular pixel clusters are visible on the lateral flank. The central region displays a structured arrangement with approximately 4-5 blobs per vertical column, maintaining a relatively uniform spatial distribution.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the high-intensity blobs, creating a grid-like pattern of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are observable on the upper lateral flank, each defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from light (dorsal) to shadow (ventral).

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated silhouettes (remoras) attached to the ventral region and near the posterior edge of the pectoral fin.
